name: How long does a typical flooring replacement project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical flooring replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a flooring replacement project varies depending on the type of flooring, the size of the area, and any necessary subfloor preparation. For a single room with basic carpet replacement, it might take one to two days. A larger project involving tile or hardwood throughout a home, including old flooring removal and subfloor leveling, could extend to a week or more. We provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific project, ensuring minimal disruption to your daily routine.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration depends on flooring type, area size, and subfloor needs; a single room might take 1-2 days, while a whole house could take a week or more.
